task:
FIX SIX CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS ON PR #816 (F2d PR4b), review round 3. Update only the existing branch f2d/pr4b-probe-publish; its head must be 43719c940f6f789e1512580d5fbb05bb233a9c59 (full SHA from git rev-parse of origin/f2d/pr4b-probe-publish; if it differs, stop and report the SHA you found). Read CLAUDE.md and design sections 8.6, 8.7 and 8.8 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f2d-wide-archetype-and-product-attachment-design.md and docs/ROADMAP.md lines ~380-404 first. All six findings are confirmed by Claude against the code; fix each with a test that FAILS on the current code (say so in your summary).

R1 (P1, blocks every publication) scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py ~line 368: the picked-page fetch node is matched by relation alias `fetch`, but the deployed build_ranked_query() names the final v3_app.system_archetype join `picked` (apps/api/src/ranking/ranking_sql.py ~238-240: `JOIN v3_app.system_archetype picked ON picked.system_id64 = page.system_id64`). So fetch_rows is always empty and picked_fetch_rows_bound fails for all 48 picked-page probes. Identify the fetch node structurally (the relation node reading the archetype relation that is joined to the ranked page outside the window/limit subtree) or by the emitted alias `picked`; prefer structural matching with the alias as a cross-check. Add a test using a plan JSON shaped exactly like PostgreSQL's EXPLAIN output for the statement build_ranked_query actually generates (alias picked).

R2 (P2, blocks valid plans) scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py ~line 275: the generic per-node bound ROW_BOUND (10,001) is applied to the GiST KNN scan node of anchored_knn_page/anchored_knn_count before the KNN-specific allowance (inner_limit + 1,000) x G. Exempt the KNN GiST node from the generic bound and apply only the KNN-specific bound to it (design 8.7 "Anchored nearest-first"). Test: a KNN plan reading inner_limit + 500 rows with G=2 passes; one exceeding (inner_limit + 1,000) x G fails.

R3 (P2) scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py ~line 305: picked_count accepts an ordinary Index Scan and only picked_page asserts Heap Fetches == 0. Design 8.7 "Picked page and count": the window node is an Index Only Scan on the expected partial with <= 10,001 actual rows AND Heap Fetches: 0, for both page and count. Apply the index-only node type and zero-heap-fetch assertions to picked_count too. Test both directions.

R4 (P2) scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py ~line 456: _candidate_count() already counts bounding-box candidates across the whole unfiltered v3_derived.system_search (all generations), and the code then multiplies by generation_count again. Measure the candidate count for the target generation only (derived_generation_id = target) and then multiply by G, exactly as design 8.7 states ("the bounding box's candidate count x G"); keep the statement bounded and parameterized. Test with two generations.

R5 (P2) scripts/operator/actions/v3-archetype-plan-probe.sh ~line 114: the standalone probe accepts any PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL. Apply exactly the same DSN binding as the publish action's api_database_url in scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh (pinned DATABASE_NAME/DATABASE_USER, host = pinned postgres container name or its IPv4 on WORKER_NETWORK, port 5432/default, no libpq target-override query parameters, DSN never printed; copy the function, actions do not source each other) with a distinct refusal code for this action (choose an unused one and document it), and in scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py check current_database()/current_user right after connecting, before any statement, refusing with that code.

R6 (P1) scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh ~line 721: after COMMIT the action only checks database rows and reports success; nothing checks the live Finder (design 8.8 / ROADMAP ~401-404). After the post-commit database verification, call the live app on the active loopback origin http://127.0.0.1:58080 with python3.14 urllib (bounded body, same helper style as the probe pairs): GET /api/archetypes/rankings?archetype=paradise&offset=0&limit=1 and POST /api/local/search with the galaxy-wide development body at from=0,size=1; require HTTP 200 and that each response envelope carries the expected published generation key/id, the attested ranking_version/ranking_sha256, and all three product identity fields design 8.8 names (read apps/api/src/models.py for the exact envelope field names; F4 relies on archetype_model_sha256). Record statuses and the identity fields in the receipt. Publication is already committed and cannot be undone here, so on failure do NOT attempt any rollback: report status "published_unhealthy" with its own nonzero exit code (choose an unused one, e.g. 80, documented), publication_performed true, db_writes_performed true, and the failing checks in failures. The protected workflow step must then fail (non-zero) so the run is red.

ALLOWED FILES: scripts/v3_archetype_plan_probe.py; scripts/operator/actions/v3-archetype-plan-probe.sh; scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh; scripts/v3_publish_derived_products.py only if needed; tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe.py; tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe_operator.py; tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products.py; tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products_operator.py; CHANGES.md (amend the PR4b entry). Nothing else.

VALIDATION TO RUN AND REPORT WITH EXACT COUNTS: bash -n on both actions; ruff check scripts tests; python -m pytest tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe.py tests/test_v3_archetype_plan_probe_operator.py tests/test_v3_plan_probe_statements.py tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products.py tests/test_v3_publish_derived_products_operator.py tests/test_f2d_operator_identity.py tests/test_v3_release_gate_f2d.py -q -p no:warnings; both identity helpers' compute output (equal). Code only; no deploy, no production access. End with: files changed; tests with counts and which new tests fail on the previous head; the exit codes you chose for R5/R6; anything you could not do.
